rows.label: qst701502_msg0001
rows.name:
As I near the end of my life,
my one regret is leaving unfinished
a vase I promised an old friend.

rows.label: qst701502_msg0002
rows.name:
I need two Spiral Mistletoe, four
Silverwing Quartz, and four
Eternity Loam. That's all.

rows.label: qst701502_msg0003
rows.name:
If you find any, I'd be grateful
if you could spare them.

rows.label: qst701502_msg0005
rows.name:
Oh, yes. I've heard that long ago,
you could find a lot of Eternity
Loam in the Rotta Forest Reserve.

rows.label: qst701502_msg0006
rows.name:
They're rare now, so I don't know
if any are left, but they're worth
looking for.

rows.label: qst701502_msg0007
rows.name:
There's no rush. If you come across
them while doing something else,
I'd appreciate it.

rows.label: qst701502_msg0008
rows.name:
Knowing him, he's probably forgotten.
Heh heh. But I want to keep my promise
before I go.

rows.label: qst701502_msg0101
rows.name:
He's old, so I don't
think he's gone too far.

rows.label: qst701502_msg0102
rows.name:
...I'm sorry. When I get
anxious, I feel a little dizzy.

rows.label: qst701502_msg0103
rows.name:
It's okay. I've come this far. It
would be pointless to collapse now.

rows.label: qst701502_msg0201
rows.name:
Oh my, is that him!? Is he having
trouble breathing... Is he wheezing?

rows.label: qst701502_msg0202
rows.name:
His throat might be inflamed. If
there's no medicine, herbs would
be best in this situation...

rows.label: qst701502_msg0203
rows.name:
There should be one with
anti-inflammatory properties.
It has a nice, cool scent.

rows.label: qst701502_msg0204
rows.name:
Don't laugh at an old woman's wisdom.
I'm no doctor, but I haven't lived
alone this long for nothing.

rows.label: qst701502_msg0205
rows.name:
I can't move from here,
but... please, help him.
